scripts.dev: npm run db:up && npm run db:seed && concurrently -k -n server,client -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @infinite-tower/server" "npm run dev -w @infinite-tower/client"
scripts.start: npm run build && NODE_ENV=production npm start -w @infinite-tower/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared && tsc -p server && tsc -p client && tsc -p shared/test && tsc -p server/test && tsc -p client/test && npm run check:layers --silent -w @infinite-tower/server
scripts.db:up: npm run env:init --silent && docker compose up -d --wait db
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && npm run db:up && npm run db:seed
